user.title: Connect BOLOLO
user.description: Enter your BOLOLO app account to retrieve bound devices on first setup. LAN is preferred by default, with cloud fallback when safe. Change the mode later in options.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the BOLOLO cloud. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The account, password or country code was rejected.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in to the same BOLOLO account as this integration.

init.title: Connection settings
init.description: Choose a connection mode. Optionally select a device to override its LAN address or passcode. LAN-only mode uses the cached inventory without refreshing cloud account bindings.

device.title: {device}
device.description: The integration discovers addresses and obtains local passcodes automatically. An IPv4 override assists discovery; allow UDP 12414, 2415 and TCP 12416. Passcodes normally do not need to be entered. Leave a field blank to clear its override.
